executive_summary: The Board of Finance meeting on August 12, 2026, covered a variety of topics including approval of previous meeting minutes, discussions on city contracts, and updates on major school construction projects. Key decisions included the approval of employment contracts for various Clerk of the Works positions, additional appropriations for state and federal grants, and significant funding for the Roxbury school replacement project. The meeting also featured an update on the progress of the city's annual financial report and a discussion on the West Broad Street Bridge rehabilitation project.

key_topics.summary: The board approved the minutes from the July 9th and July 24th meetings unanimously.
The board discussed and approved an agreement with Graviton Consulting for Oracle ERP support, highlighting cost savings compared to Oracle Consulting Services.

key_topics.topic: West Hill and Roxbury School Construction Updates
key_topics.summary: Updates were provided on the progress of the West Hill and Roxbury school construction projects, including timelines and financials.
The board approved additional funding for the Roxbury school replacement project, with conditions on approving the final GMP.
